name: Kobweb Official Website
description:
Create web apps in Kotlin!

Kobweb is an opinionated framework built on top of Compose HTML.

It includes everything you need to build rich, dynamic websites, as well as web applications, while being able to leverage the greater Kotlin ecosystem.

name: YouTube Redesigned
description:
Reimagine YouTube: A Stunning, Next-Gen Experience.

A sleek, modern YouTube redesign crafted with Kotlin/JS and Kobweb. Experience your favorite content like never before! Features dynamic drawers, intuitive playlists, immersive theater mode, and keyboard shortcuts.

name: Pierre Roy's Portfolio
description: Hi, I'm Pierre Roy, an IT student passionate about computer science and programming. Discover my projects and blog on this website. Entirely made in Kobweb and Compose HTML.
tags: Portfolio, Open Source, Complex UI, Animations

name: SVG to Compose
description: Convert SVG and Android Vector Drawables into Jetpack Compose ImageVector code. CLI tool and Gradle plugin for Kotlin Multiplatform.

name: Itami Mobile Portfolio
description: Personal portfolio website built with Kobweb. Showcasing mobile development projects with modern animations and effects.
tags: Portfolio, Open Source, Animations, Complex UI

name: Android Dev Perú
description: The Android Dev Perú community site and conference landing page. Open source community website for the Peruvian Android developer community, built with Kobweb.

name: Musaib Shabir Portfolio
description: Portfolio of Musaib Shabir, a Computer Science Engineering graduate specializing in modern Android development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Features clean professional design.

name: Weaved
description: Weaved is a browser extension made with Kobweb and a mobile app that lets you highlight and comment on any website, embedding discussions directly into the web. Join the conversation and see what others are saying in context. The homepage features live preview code shared from the extension module itself.
tags: Collaboration, Browser Extension, Unique Use Case

name: Kotfolio
description: Kotfolio is a minimalistic and clean open-source portfolio template built with Kobweb. Features a sleek black color scheme, responsive design, and serves as a ready-to-use portfolio starter for Kotlin developers.

name: Kore Library
description:
Kore is a modern, open-source, and easy-to-use Kotlin library for Minecraft datapack development.
Designed to be simple, fast, and easy to use. The documentation site features polished design with improved tree navigation.

name: SorenKai
description: Soren Kai is a writer and technologist exploring how technology shapes human connection, identity, and belonging. Personal site with multilingual support including Spanish /es/ route.

name: Binay Shaw Portfolio
description: Updated personal portfolio showcasing animations and project management style portfolio sections. Built with Kobweb featuring modern animations and smooth transitions.

name: Neotica
description: Neotica is a mobile development research platform. Built with Kobweb with careful attention to component structure and hover behavior. Features a clean, modern design.

name: BordeauxKt
description:
BordeauxKt is a user group serving the Kotlin language and its ecosystem, aimed at developers in Bordeaux and its metropolitan area.

We organize evenings around technical presentations to discuss the different uses of Kotlin: server-side development, mobile, web, or native.

name: Phantom Portfolio
description: Personal portfolio website built with Kobweb. Clean, futuristic, animated design with a focus on presenting developer projects.
